knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Loose grit can scratch the paint under contact.
Sensitive components and people are kept clear of pressure.

practicalCriteria: Completes a non-contact pre-wash on a sample panel before any contact.
Inspects hoses and the spray pattern before use, and records the result.
De-energises equipment before a simulated service.
passRule: Grit removed before contact, equipment inspected, and servicing done with equipment de-energised. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Spray directed at camera housing or seal
